common_sense.why: Deciding not to re-initiate a contraindicated cardiac medication and requiring an electrophysiology consult depends on clinical judgment and specialty guidance, not general common sense.

convention: Clinical/medical convention: contraindicated medications (e.g., due to prior QT prolongation) should not be re-initiated without specialist (electrophysiology/cardiology) consultation.
